prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `classify` and `area` in src/lib.rs. Both return `None` unless all three sides are finite, strictly positive, and satisfy the strict triangle inequality. `classify` returns `"equilateral"`, `"isosceles"` or `"scalene"`. `area` uses Heron's formula. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
